title: ‘World’s most remote festival’ sells out final edition in record time
summary: The world’s “most remote music festival”, Australia’s Birdsville Big Red Bash, sold out its final edition in record time as fans and organisers prepare to say goodbye after a dozen editions. Roughly 8,000 tickets flew out in under an hour for Queensland’s three-day outback camping festival, which organisers confirmed last month that 2027 would be the final instalment. This year’s event was cancelled after “once-in-a-generation” widespread flooding left the remote site underwater, organisers said.
